lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary cluster of three high-intensity circular blobs is arranged in a triangular configuration posterior to the fifth gill slit, with subsequent larger blobs forming semi-regular horizontal rows along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, forming a discernible grid pattern of nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge, extending from the gill region posteriorly.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the primary visible pectoral fin displays a distinct irregular notch or indentation roughly mid-way along its length.
other_distinctive_markers: A transition in patterning is observed from high-density, small-diameter spots on the rostrum and head to larger, more widely spaced blobs on the trunk.
